visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with vibrant pink hair, wearing a loose white button-up shirt and black trousers, sits relaxed on a wooden bench surrounded by green foliage. She smiles and strikes poses while taking a selfie with a smartphone, holding it at eye level in the bright daylight. (2) The woman's expression suddenly shifts to concern and distress. She stares intently at her phone's dark screen, tapping it repeatedly and looking around as if searching for a solution. The lighting is bright, natural daylight in an urban park setting with a grey brick building behind. (3) A high-action cinematic sequence is spliced in, showing a large aircraft engulfed in smoke and a figure falling from the sky. This creates a dramatic, meme-like contrast to the woman's minor technical problem of a dead battery. (4) A young man wearing a black cap, a black-and-white layered short-sleeve shirt, and black shorts performs an athletic flip on a paved courtyard. His movements are fluid and energetic, set against a backdrop of modern residential buildings. (5) The man walks confidently toward the camera, holding a set of three compact, square-shaped power banks in muted green, grey, and cream colors. He gestures with his hands while speaking directly to the viewer in a friendly manner. (6) The scene cuts to a medium shot of the man handing the green power bank to the woman. She receives it with a surprised and happy expression. The setting remains the same outdoor area with benches and plants. (7) A series of close-ups showcase the device's technical details. A white cable is plugged into a phone's port; the power bank is shown magnetically attaching to the back of a phone; and its digital LED display shows the battery percentage. (8) Further demonstrations show the power bank charging an Apple Watch and wireless earbuds simultaneously on a white surface. The man's hands are seen pointing at the built-in USB-C and Lightning cables, emphasizing their convenience and portability. (9) The man and woman appear together in a final frame, looking at the camera and smiling. The man holds the power bank while they engage in a brief, cheerful conversation. They both stand up and walk away together, exiting the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with soft, ambient outdoor noise, including a gentle wind floor and faint distant city hum. A light, upbeat acoustic pop background track starts playing at a low volume, providing a calm and cheerful atmosphere. (2) A female voice speaks with high-pitched, exaggerated distress and a fast speech rate, exclaiming about her phone's battery running out. The vocal arousal is high, conveying urgency, followed by a brief moment of relative silence. (3) The audio abruptly transitions to a high-intensity cinematic soundscape with deep, percussive thuds and a swelling orchestral score. Loud, broadband explosion sound effects and high-frequency rushing wind sounds dominate the mix for a few seconds. (4) A sharp whoosh transition SFX leads into a high-energy electronic dance music (EDM) track with a prominent, rhythmic beat at approximately 124 BPM. The bass is punchy, and the melodic synth texture is bright and motivating. (5) A male voice enters with a clear, authoritative, yet friendly professional tone. His articulation is enunciated and clear, with a moderate speech rate and rising intonation at the end of introductory phrases. The speech-music balance is well-mastered. (6) Specific sound effects are integrated, including a high-pitched digital chime or 'ding' when the phone begins to charge. The sound of the magnetic attachment is represented by a soft, percussive 'snap' effect added in post-production. (7) The male narration continues, detailing technical specifications with a consistent, energetic volume. The BGM remains constant in the background, maintaining its tempo. Occasional reactions from the female voice are heard, characterized by happy, high-pitched vocalizations. (8) The final phase features a dialogue between the two speakers. Their voices are relaxed and casual, with natural pauses and a lower arousal level compared to the initial hook. The music subtly fades out as they walk away.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video's primary purpose is to promote and sell the aircolor 6-in-1 magnetic wireless power bank. It uses a comedic hook (a dead phone battery) followed by a high-energy demonstration of features including its compact size, magnetic charging, built-in cables, and safety certifications, targeted at mobile users who value convenience and aesthetic design.
